::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 4th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 28-29
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

There is something in [Mr Freeman](people/person_523.qmd)’s [essays](other_books/otherbook_884.qmd) that he wants me to look at. Would you be so kind as to let me have them - it is the volume with Charles the Bold in it

I hope the two French histories will come out right at last![^1]

I always suppose some one is making holiday in August so I shall direct this so as to be opened by either you or [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: E. A. Freeman, who was the editor of the 'Historical Course for Schools' series, was critical of CMY's contribution, the volume on the *History of France*.  His essay on 'Charles the Bold' was published in the second volume of his *Historical Essays* (1873). She was also writing another *History of France* for Macmillan, in the 'Historical Primers' series edited by J. R. Green.
